applicable_when: The kernel is a GEMM (M=7840, N=40, K=240) running on H200 SXM5 with ALLOW_TF32=False, forcing tl.dot to use scalar FP32 FFMA at 67 TFLOPS instead of Tensor Cores at 989 TFLOPS (~14.7x gap). Compute SOL is only 19.52% and the scheduler issues instructions only 22.7% of cycles. The 128 registers/thread cap occupancy at 25% theoretical (only 6.25% achieved). Enabling TF32 (allow_tf32=True) routes tl.dot through Tensor Cores. K=240 is well below the K>512 threshold where TF32 mantissa truncation causes accumulated error to exceed atol=1e-3. Additionally, reducing BLOCK_M and BLOCK_N from 64x64 to 32x32 cuts register pressure, doubling theoretical occupancy and increasing grid coverage from 123 to 490 blocks across 132 SMs.
